description: User-facing entry names for the four core review Flows (#2016). The entry name is what a person types or asks for; the Flow id and version are what the judgment is recorded against. This document carries no host vocabulary on purpose: how an entry is surfaced belongs to agents/contracts/adapter-map.json, and which Flow it resolves to belongs here, so the two hosts have nothing to disagree about.

review-plan.description: Can execution safely start from this plan?

review-replan.description: Is this plan change justified and does it leave the upstream contract intact?

review-task.description: Is there evidence to declare this task DONE?

review-final.description: Are the goal and requirements met, rather than merely every task closed?
